items.text: The acknowledgement letter was perfect and saved me ten minutes.
Draft listed the incident date as March 3 but the claim says March 8.
Letters ignore the latest adjuster note when a claim has more than 20 notes.
Copilot kept spinning and then errored for about two hours this morning; I wrote letters by hand.
Error: draft unavailable. Again.
Several teams lost the morning to the outage. What is the plan so this does not happen during renewal season?
Drafts are suddenly much longer - status updates are now a full page.
Takes forever to generate today.
Rejections on my team doubled since Thursday; the new tone is too chatty for letters close to a denial.
Waited about 12 seconds for a two-line acknowledgement.
Draft said the deductible was $500; the policy shows $1,000.
Much better again this afternoon. Please keep the letters short.
Still slow this morning.
Draft for claim 4471 said 'your loss is covered' before the coverage review was complete.
Bullet points render as asterisks in the PDF export.
Can it draft letters in Spanish? About a third of my customers prefer Spanish.
Used the old mailing address even though the customer moved last week; the note was added on Monday.
Quality is good overall and my team's handling time is down a lot.
The amount in the payment letter was rounded to the nearest dollar.
Would love a bulk mode for the backlog letters.
Tone feels robotic for condolence-type letters.
Please confirm how the coverage-language incident on claim 4471 is being prevented going forward.
The fallback template mode during yesterday's ClaimCore blip worked well.
The letter header shows the wrong office phone number for the Dallas branch.
